import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_name, organism="9606"):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:{organism}+AND+reviewed:true&format=json"
    res = requests.get(url).json()
    results = []
    for entry in res.get("results", []):
        acc = entry["primaryAccession"]
        gene = [g["geneName"]["value"] for g in entry.get("genes", []) if "geneName" in g]
        length = entry["sequence"]["length"]
        desc = entry["proteinDescription"]["recommendedName"]["fullName"]["value"]
        results.append((acc, gene, length, desc))
    return results

print("KLHDC3:", get_uniprot_info("KLHDC3"))
print("PSMD10:", get_uniprot_info("PSMD10"))
